subject: First-week onboarding playbook and calendar owners

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Mills <jared.mills@acmehealth.com>, implementations@acmehealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: First-week onboarding playbook and calendar owners

Hi Jared / Acme implementation team,

Thanks again for narrowing the go-live window with us — excited to get week one locked in. Attached is a lightweight playbook for week 1 (agenda + prework) and a draft host rotation. Please confirm the attendee list and whether we should adjust any times for your PST folks.

High-level week-1 cadence (proposed):
- Day 0 (pre-call): access checks + host tech run (30m)
- Day 1: Kickoff + architecture review (60m)
- Day 2: Integration walkthrough (90m)
- Day 3: Operations handoff / runbook Q&A (45m)

Ask:
1) Confirm primary attendees for each session (names + emails)
2) Confirm timezone preference (we've drafted in PDT)
3) Any compliance folks to include (SOC/Security contact)?

Attaching: 2027-week1-playbook.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB) — includes agenda, prework checklist, and a suggested bridge owner list. Also attached host-rotation.csv (CSV) with proposed moderators per session.

Tentative links (will send calendar invites once we confirm):
- Kickoff (Day 1): https://zoom.us/j/0000000001
- Integration (Day 2): https://zoom.us/j/0000000002
- Ops Handoff (Day 3): https://zoom.us/j/0000000003

I can shift any of these +/- 90 minutes if needed.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Olga — this looks good. A couple quick notes:
- We prefer the kickoff at 10:30am PT rather than the 9am slot in the doc (several engineers are not available until after 10).
- Please include our security lead, Daniel Park (daniel.park@acmehealth.com), on the Ops Handoff session — he'll want to review retention and logging details.
- Confirm the expected attendees from Redwood for the integration deep-dive (we want the runtime/infra owner present).

I'll loop our implementation inbox on confirmations.
